ScopeNotes: Account-age/prior-season cohorts are operational facts, never skill labels; preparation levels are frozen effective entry levels.
Room choices are one bounded source snapshot; database sections share a later read-only snapshot. They are not a cross-source conservation equation.
Historical missing offer, profile, wallet or transaction response remains unknown. Legal over-base HP is not an anomaly.
Market depth, zero balances and remaining activity budgets are as-of-query;48h conversion uses fully exposed mature listings separately from shortened/censored listings.
Shop/activity overlap is descriptive, not causal purchase displacement. Equipment trade templates come from immutable transaction responses, not current equipment.
First-extraction/recovery facts use committed equipment movements; outstanding recoveries are right-censored, not permanent-loss verdicts.
Red timelines retain quota/mint and original owner movements; truncation and unknown ownership are explicit. Counts and amounts are exact strings, currencies stay separate.

report.scope: Persistent account-currency flows; provisional field loot, physical items and per-attempt playtime are separate collectors.

report.clockBasis: Authoritative room clock, clipped and unioned per player; includes in-room waiting/disconnect and simulated recovery time, not measured human activity.
report.netBasis: Account currency delta excluding temporary refresh reserve/refund, minus refresh reserve committed within this window. Includes player market transfers; unknown durations are never assigned zero rates.

report.scope: Three crafting event types only; lobby dimensions remain unknown. Reforge mutates an existing item; learning retains its sample.

Difficulty completion, committed destruction and original asset-domain archive markers. Wallet balances are not archival amount snapshots. Lobby/archive dimensions are not played difficulty; archive is not destruction or mint.

report.clockBasis: Original room UTC start plus authoritative logical elapsed, including recovery time.
report.scope: Room observations only: potential choices, carried items, exit and relic custody pending asset settlement. These are not additional account credits, irreversible destruction or proof of settlement commit.
report.combatScope: Cumulative since each row's declared observation start, not time-window deltas. Partial/saturated rows are explicit. Advance ticks are actual combat-state advances, not human active time.

report.scope: Equipment identities only. Creation rows count mint once; placement, owner/custody moves and archive are not additional mint. Supply is the known lifetime subset; current stocks are as-of-query, not opening balances or economic health.
